StringWithMarkup.String: P-toluic acid is a white powder. Sublimes. (NTP, 1992)
P-toluic acid is a methylbenzoic acid in which the methyl substituent is located at position 4. It is a conjugate acid of a p-toluate.
p-toluic acid has been reported in Aloe africana, Homo sapiens, and other organisms with data available.
